Container.Name: domain-watchdog
Container.Overview: Domain Watchdog monitors domain lifecycle via RDAP, sends alerts when domains change status, and can automatically attempt registration when a domain drops.[br][br]Requires an existing PostgreSQL and Redis container on the same Docker network.[br][br]Also deploy the domain-watchdog-worker container from this repo.[br][br]Before starting: create the database in your PostgreSQL container:[br]docker exec -it YOUR_POSTGRES_CONTAINER psql -U YOUR_USER -c "CREATE DATABASE domainwatchdog;"
Container.Requires: PostgreSQL container | Redis container | Both on the same Docker network | Also install domain-watchdog-worker

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port to access the Domain Watchdog web interface.

Config.Name: App Secret
Config.Description: Random secret key. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Secure Cookies
Config.Description: Set to true if behind a reverse proxy with SSL (recommended). Set to false for plain HTTP direct access.

Config.Name: Redis Async DSN
Config.Description: Redis connection for async messages. Format: redis://CONTAINER_NAME:PORT/messages

Config.Name: Redis RDAP Low DSN
Config.Description: Redis connection for low-priority RDAP messages. Change redis to your Redis container name if different.

Config.Name: Redis RDAP High DSN
Config.Description: Redis connection for high-priority RDAP messages. Change redis to your Redis container name if different.

Config.Name: Redis Lock DSN
Config.Description: Redis connection for distributed locking. Format: redis://CONTAINER_NAME:PORT

Config.Name: Mailer DSN
Config.Description: SMTP connection for email alerts. Example: smtp://user:pass@smtp.example.com:587 — Leave as null://null to disable.

Config.Name: Mailer From Address
Config.Description: Sender address for outgoing notification emails.
